whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Fitness Connection & Wellness Centre,

I noticed your gym has built an amazing 5.0★ reputation with 59 reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke fitness centre ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/fitnessconnection

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team The Fitness Connection & Wellness Centre, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for clients around Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai. Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
